soundness_flags.label: ass:causal-mean-version
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited LMTP paper states support and sequential-randomization assumptions, not the proposal's all-treatment equality to a chosen continuous observed-regression version; retag this as a novel explicit version-bridge condition and justify it.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: prop:causal-bridge
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The causal interpretation assumes, rather than derives, a pointwise all-treatment causal-mean/version bridge.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The headline statistical minimax and honest-length results concern the observed-data functional; interpretation as the clamp-policy mean holds only under the explicitly retagged version-bridge premise together with consistency, exchangeability, and support.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 850, Assumptions 1-3 and Theorem 1; p. 851, threshold non-pathwise-differentiability discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The publication identifies LMTP effects under positivity and sequential-randomization assumptions, and explicitly says its continuous threshold example is not pathwise differentiable; it does not state the proposal's all-treatment equality between a causal mean and a selected continuous observed-regression version.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:math/0410354, journal-version abstract corresponding to Mathematical Methods of Statistics 14 (2005)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies pointwise regression estimation at a fixed point under a regularly varying degenerate random design and gives a minimax pointwise rate.
The paper develops bias-aware honest confidence intervals for scalar nonparametric regression functionals using kernel or local-polynomial estimators and analyzes optimal bandwidth and efficiency.
The published article concerns data-adaptive effect-modifier identification for stochastic shift interventions using cross-validated TMLE, rather than a deterministic moving-clamp minimax problem.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag the all-treatment causal-mean/version equality as novel and add a concrete scientific data-generating rationale for when its pointwise version is credible.
Add a short corollary that states the fixed-positive-threshold Gaiffas exponent and explicitly contrasts it with the new atom attenuation and critical threshold.
Make the lower-bound witness family explicit in the derivation plan, including the baseline Bernoulli regression and localized bump amplitudes that preserve the Hölder radius and bounded outcomes.

recommended_next_step: Revise the causal version-bridge tag and justification, retain the observed-data minimax kernel, then advance this field-or-better angle to Stage 0.
